verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents its own local `dev` instance, an in-memory embedded mode, and a `helix chef` bootstrapper that seeds example data, all using the same queries as Cloud. That lets users test against an environment separate from production. However, it never describes a dedicated sandbox, staging, or branch environment, and never explicitly guarantees isolation from production data. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documented isolation from production data, a way to clone or branch production safely for tests, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
